text: A claim whose spec names `geometry.audit` on a deliverable document gets a run in the record whose outcome is the canvas core's for that revision. A planted twin with an item floating 0.2 m above the floor makes the run fail and the verdict FAIL, naming the item. On the merge base the spec entry has no `run` line and is dropped, and the test fails, naming the check.
A patch that makes a new revision after a PASS makes that verdict stale, and `deep_run` runs the check again on the new revision.
`logic.determinism` named in a build without `logic` reads BLOCKED with `module_missing`, never PASS.
`deep show --check` reads its result from the recorded runs; a presented document with no run never reads PASS.
